truthPolicy: verbatim frozen independent truth; never generated from project output

common.internalForces: N tension positive; M sagging positive; V=dM/dx
common.units: values below are SI unless explicitly stated; UI default is t-mm-MPa-N-s
common.validationOrder: nonfinite -> nonpositive -> geometric degeneracy -> singular stiffness

cases.title: 梁弯曲 4×4 子矩阵
cases.inputs: E=200 GPa; I=8.0e-6 m^4; L=4 m; dofs=[v_i,theta_i,v_j,theta_j]
cases.unitsNotes: K11 N/m; K12 N; K22 N*m; matrix indices in source start at 1

cases.title: 均布载荷一致节点荷载
cases.inputs: same as E01; full-span q_y=-10000 N/m
cases.source: EB; integral(N^T q dx) hand integration; 2026-07-19

cases.title: 含轴向自由度的 6×6 梁单元刚度矩阵
cases.inputs: horizontal element; L=4 m; E=200 GPa; A=0.01 m^2; I=8.0e-6 m^4
cases.unitsNotes: entries retain mixed N/m, N, N*m dimensions by row/column DOF
cases.tolerance: nonzero relative 1e-12; rigid-mode residual <=1e-6 N and <=1e-6 N*m
cases.source: DSM axial bar stiffness block plus P2-BEAM-E01 bending block; 2026-07-19

cases.title: 简支梁跨中集中力
cases.inputs: L=4 m; E=200 GPa; A=0.01 m^2; I=8e-6 m^4; P_y=-40000 N at x=2 m; nodes x=[0,2,4] m; v(0)=v(4)=0; u(0)=0; end rotations free
cases.tolerance: displacement/force/moment relative 1e-8; zeros use common absolute tolerance
cases.source: EB simply-supported central point-load closed form; 2026-07-19

cases.title: 简支梁全跨均布载荷
cases.inputs: L=4 m; E=200 GPa; A=0.01 m^2; I=8e-6 m^4; q_y=-10000 N/m; simple supports; meshes n=1,2,4; consistent loads
cases.tolerance: listed discrete values relative 1e-8; extremum position 1e-9 m
cases.source: EB closed form and Hermite interpolation hand calculation; 2026-07-19

cases.title: 悬臂梁全跨均布载荷
cases.inputs: L=3 m; E=200 GPa; A=0.01 m^2; I=8e-6 m^4; q_y=-4000 N/m; fixed i; three 1 m elements
cases.tolerance: nodal relative 1e-8; field key points relative 1e-6

cases.title: 集中力矩与多载荷叠加
cases.inputs: cantilever L=2 m; E=200 GPa; A=0.01 m^2; I=8e-6 m^4; free-end P_y=-6000 N and Mz=+4000 N*m; fixed i
cases.expected: Ry=6000 N; reaction Mz=8000 N*m; theta=-0.0025 rad; v=-0.005 m; P-only theta=-0.0075,v=-0.01; M-only theta=+0.005,v=+0.005; total equals component-wise sum
cases.source: linear superposition of two EB closed forms; 2026-07-19

cases.title: 梁轴向自由度、轴力与端力
cases.inputs: horizontal single beam L=2 m; E=200 GPa; A=0.001 m^2; I=8e-6 m^4; i fixed; j free; Fx_j=+100000 N
cases.expected: u_j=+0.001 m; v_j=theta_j=0; N=+100000 N tension; sigma=+100 MPa; Rix=-100000 N; Riy=Mzi=0; local element-on-node end force=[+100000,0,0,-100000,0,0]; recovered i+ and j- N=+100000 N
cases.tolerance: displacement/axial force/stress relative 1e-10; zeros use common absolute tolerance

cases.title: 网格收敛
cases.expected: reference v_mid=-0.0208333333333 m, reactions=[20000,20000] N, recovered Mmax=20000 N*m at 2 m; Hermite-only v_mid=[-0.0166666666667,-0.0208333333333,-0.0208333333333] m; absolute errors=[0.00416666666667,0,0] m; error must not increase; n=2,4 pass reference; recovered moment for all meshes passes A02
cases.source: A02 closed form and shape-function substitution; 2026-07-19

cases.title: 约束不足/机构
cases.inputs: one beam element E=200 GPa,A=0.01 m^2,I=8e-6 m^4,L=4 m; all u,v,theta free; Fy_j=-1 N
cases.expected: reject before or during factorization; no displacement/reaction/success result

errors.message: 整体刚度矩阵奇异：存在刚体位移或约束不足

cases.title: 非法材料/几何/零长度
cases.inputs: independent variants: E=0,-1 Pa,NaN; A=0,-1 m^2,+Infinity; I=0,-1 m^4,+Infinity; coincident nodes L=0; other values from E03
cases.expected: do not enter assembly/solve; Chinese message includes field name and illegal value
